helpers.how: Explains lessons, answers craft questions and helps you turn what you are learning into story choices you can review.
Turns your Foundations work into organized PLAN suggestions for you to accept, edit or reject.
Creates Wyrmwood challenges and rival moves that let you practise story craft without changing the game state.
Explains how your Wyrmwood response lines up with the lesson and the evidence in the scene.
Brings specialist advice together into clear creative options without overruling what you want.
Checks whether beats connect, stakes rise and the 24 Block / 96 Mini-Block story map holds together.
Spots continuity problems and points to the accepted story evidence that conflicts.
Gives an independent pressure test of story clarity, pacing, characters, dialogue and audience fit.
Develops reviewable poster, key-art, teaser and trailer ideas when you choose to create campaign visuals.
Looks at the rendered interface for clipping, overlap, layout and visual-continuity problems.
Searches approved Guildhall history and returns short summaries with receipts so you can trace where they came from.
Welcomes callers and helps keep eligible public Community rooms respectful, relevant and safer while recognizing that difficult fictional story material is still legitimate creative work.
Walks PlotPickle like a first-time writer and records where the experience is confusing, difficult or easy to abandon.
Represents the test gates that say PASS or FAIL from evidence rather than opinion.
Packages verified failures for an approved repair worker and keeps the handoff bounded by the test evidence.
Reviews code changes for hard-to-maintain patterns and discoverability problems without writing or merging code.
Turns already-verified engineering findings into concise GitHub-ready summaries without changing repository state.
